sections.indications_and_usage: EnBrace HR® is indicated in the TREATMENT of vitamin deficiency - specifically vitamin B12 deficiency - and TREATMENT of hyperhomocysteinemia due to vitamin B12 and/or folate deficiency, and the PREVENTION of deficiency of the vitamin B12 cofactor, l-methylfolate. Requirements of vitamin B9 and/or vitamin B12 in excess of normal due to pregnancy can usually be met with oral supplementation.
sections.adverse_reactions: Mild transient diarrhea, polycythemia vera, itching, transitory exanthema, feeling of swelling of entire body may occur with administration of vitamin B12. Allergic sensitization has been reported following both oral and parenteral administration of folic acid.
sections.dosage_and_administration: The recommended dosage is one (1) capsule daily, preferably on an empty stomach. Dosage may be adjusted by a healthcare provider based on individual patient needs. As a general rule reticulocyte plasma count, folate and vitamin B12 status must be obtained prior to treatment. Do not exceed the recommended dose. Call your medical practitioner about side effects. You may report side effects by calling (866) 280-5961.
sections.boxed_warning: Oval, brownish-orange softgel capsule with imprint ENL.
